headline: Build systems. Survive chaos.
subhead: A real-time multiplayer game where every player architects a distributed system against the same live traffic and the same failures. Black Friday rushes, datacenter outages, viral floods: in your browser, with friends, scored every second.
invite_only_hint: The host shares the invite link directly with players.
live_sub: Open matches you can watch on the big screen or jump into.
no_live: No live matches right now. Be the one who starts the next game.
step1_body: Pick a real-world scenario, create the match, and share one link. Players join from any browser; the audience gets a live stage screen.
step2_body: Design your architecture in the build phase: load balancers, caches, queues, replicas. When the round locks, live traffic hits every player at once.
step3_body: Outages and slowdowns strike mid-round. Keep latency and errors inside the SLO to build a streak multiplier. Resilience beats raw spend.
scenarios_sub: Every match replays a real operational incident: scripted traffic, scripted failures, tuned scoring.
closing_sub: Free, in the browser, no setup. Host a match for your team, your class, or your meetup, and put the audience screen on the projector.
footer_tag: The Arena runs on Dinamos, the free hands-on platform for distributed systems.
